apps.name: Danvers
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: rendered-page capture, server fallback and duplicate handling form a documented, packaged Firefox workflow.
apps.summary: Save rendered web pages to Karakeep from Firefox, including mobile browsers.
apps.description: Captures the page as your browser rendered it and uploads an archive to Karakeep. Supports a secondary server and configurable handling of existing bookmarks.

screenshots.alt: Danvers saving a page to Karakeep

apps.name: Game & Pebble
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: games, menus and persistent scores are implemented; installing the app requires a local Pebble SDK build.
apps.summary: Play ten arcade games on Pebble watches, with persistent high scores.
apps.description: A single Pebble app with maze chase, snake, asteroids, falling blocks, breakout and other arcade games. Targets Pebble Time 2 and other modern colour and monochrome Pebbles.

screenshots.caption: Illustrative previews of the game screens.

apps.name: Hoarder (mirror)
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: upstream bookmarking and mobile workflows are substantial, but development is active and this mirror has no independent packaging.
apps.summary: Self-hosted bookmarks, notes, images and full-text search.
apps.description: L-K-M's mirror of the upstream Hoarder project, now called Karakeep. Saves links and media, archives pages, and supports optional language-model tagging and mobile clients.

apps.name: ia-get
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: downloading and authenticated-item access are implemented; the fork's installation path is build-from-source.
apps.summary: Download Internet Archive items from the command line, including authenticated items.
apps.description: A fork of wimpysworld/ia-get with archive.org account authentication for restricted items. Includes a standard-input password option and build targets for macOS, Windows and Linux.

apps.name: ia-get Docker Wrapper
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: queue persistence and the web UI have a documented Compose setup; deployment remains intended for trusted local use.
apps.summary: Queue and monitor Internet Archive downloads through a self-hosted web interface.
apps.description: Wraps ia-get in a Docker Compose service with a persistent download queue and optional web UI. Designed for local and NAS-style deployments.

apps.name: ImageContentDetector
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: the JPEG-to-EXIF command-line workflow is implemented; legacy Windows tooling and Azure setup limit ease of use.
apps.summary: Write image descriptions and keywords into JPEG metadata using Azure Computer Vision.
apps.description: A Windows command-line tool that processes a directory of JPEGs and stores Azure's returned descriptions and keywords in EXIF fields. Can skip already-described files and preserve existing descriptions.

apps.name: Kagi × Karakeep
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: a focused, packaged search integration with configuration, connection testing and documented installation.
apps.summary: Show matching Karakeep bookmarks alongside Kagi search results in Firefox.
apps.description: Reads the current Kagi query, searches your configured Karakeep server and places saved links in a results card. Configure the server, token and result count in the extension.

screenshots.alt: Karakeep bookmarks beside Kagi search results

apps.name: Hoarder's Pipette (mirror)
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: upstream search integration and browser installation are established; this mirror has no separately maintained build.
apps.summary: Include saved Karakeep bookmarks in browser search results.
apps.description: L-K-M's mirror of DanSnow/hoarder-pipette. Queries Karakeep while you search and displays matching bookmarks across supported search engines.

apps.name: Lern Deutsch (Pebble)
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: flashcards, progress and scoring are implemented and packaged; hardware support is limited to Pebble Time 2.
apps.summary: Learn German vocabulary with Chinese-language flashcards on Pebble Time 2.
apps.description: Flip and self-score cards across four difficulty levels, with missed cards repeated until the round is complete. Includes German-to-Chinese and Chinese-to-German directions, streaks and progress statistics.

screenshots.caption: Preview of the vocabulary and progress screens.

apps.name: Manors & Menaces
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: local, AI and online play are implemented with a tutorial; mobile packaging and self-hosted setup still need refinement.
apps.summary: A turn-based fantasy board game for two to four players, with local, AI and online modes.
apps.description: Build roads and manors, manage harvests and disrupt rival plans with units and Royal Writs. Play in a browser, desktop app or Android client; online matches use an optional self-hosted server.

apps.name: opencode-mystatus
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: quota checks and the terminal watch dashboard have documented run paths; installation and provider configuration are manual.
apps.summary: Check AI subscription quotas from the terminal, once or in a live watch mode.
apps.description: A fork of vbgate/opencode-mystatus adding a standalone terminal dashboard, a configurable refresh interval and a countdown to the next update. Runs through Node or Bun.

apps.name: Pararena 2
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: the original game and multiplayer modes run through a packaged modern port; port-specific compatibility is still developing.
apps.summary: Play John Calhoun's classic Macintosh game on modern desktops and Android.
apps.description: L-K-M's SDL3 port of the original Pararena 2 sources, forked from softdorothy/Pararena2. Preserves the original game code and supports gamepads, fullscreen, multiplayer modes and AI opponents.

apps.name: Expand URL
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: redirect inspection and parameter handling are implemented; installation is through Raycast development tooling.
apps.summary: Inspect shortened URLs one redirect hop at a time from Raycast.
apps.description: Shows each redirect's status, host, path and query parameters. Copy any hop, strip identified tracking parameters or inspect the chain step by step. Requires the Raycast app on macOS.

apps.name: RelayBar Scion
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: forwarding profiles and remote-file access are packaged; the fork's update and documentation paths are less refined.
apps.summary: Manage SSH port forwards and remote file access from a Mac menu bar.
apps.description: A fork of lx2026/RelayBar with an app-owned status item that restores its visibility on launch. Manages structured forwarding profiles and can browse remote files over SSH and SFTP. Requires macOS 13 or later.

apps.name: RSS Spy
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: feed discovery, validation and URL copying form a focused, packaged Firefox tool with documented installation.
apps.summary: Discover and validate RSS, Atom and JSON feeds for the current Firefox page.
apps.description: Finds feed candidates in page metadata, links and common feed paths, then validates them in the background. The popup lists discovered feeds and copies their URLs.

apps.name: Scratch
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: editing, local storage and note navigation inherit substantial upstream functionality; fork-specific builds require source setup.
apps.summary: Edit local Markdown notes with a visual editor, source mode and optional Git sync.
apps.description: A fork of erictli/scratch with changes to the editor, settings and note service. Notes stay as Markdown files; the app also supports wikilinks, diagrams, maths, a command palette and an optional folder tree.

apps.name: Shiori Web Extension (mirror)
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: upstream bookmark management is described as usable beta software; browser and server-version compatibility are constrained.
apps.summary: Save and remove Shiori bookmarks from your browser.
apps.description: L-K-M's mirror of go-shiori/shiori-web-ext. Connect the extension to your Shiori server to manage bookmarks without leaving the current page. Its documentation identifies Firefox as the tested browser.

apps.name: Skip that Noise
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: a narrow artist-blacklist workflow with signed installation and documented operation.
apps.summary: Automatically skip selected artists on YouTube Music in Firefox.
apps.description: Keep an artist blacklist and skip matching tracks as they play. Published releases provide a signed Firefox extension.

apps.name: Starling
apps.summary: A FunKey OS fork for the Anbernic RG Nano with a cross-system favourites launcher.
apps.description: Adds a favourites list to the handheld's game launcher while retaining the stock FunKey OS emulator setup. Firmware and complete SD-card images target the RG Nano specifically.
apps.maturityNote: Latest builds compile in CI but have not been tested on hardware.

apps.name: Tiltburst
apps.summary: A digital pinball project for desktop computers and converted pinball cabinets.
apps.description: An in-progress pinball project with text-authored tables and planned local multiplayer. The current source tree is an early scaffold rather than a playable game.
apps.maturityNote: Early scaffold; nothing playable yet.

apps.name: WhatsApp Backup
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: login, sync, search and export are implemented; operation remains a trusted-network, self-hosted workflow.
apps.summary: Back up and browse WhatsApp messages and media through a local web interface.
apps.description: A Dockerized service around wacli, with QR login, synchronization status, message search and plain-text exports. Includes reconnection handling and an optional connection-loss email notification.

screenshots.alt: WhatsApp Backup message browser and synchronization status
